title: Nuclide identity and exact isotope accounting through chemical transformation
description:
Exact branch normalization, isotope and carrier conservation, and complete radiotracer record retention under arbitrary finite extension.

Maria Smith develops nuclide identity, radioactive chemical transformation, counted activity, branch yields, radiochemical equilibrium, isotope exchange, equilibrium and kinetic fractionation, tracer custody, species separation and fission-product distribution. Includes full mathematical arguments, all eleven 256-candidate grammars, 1,506 distinct empty-axiom audited Lean declarations, measured activity intervals and complete original source outcomes. Pinned V3/V4 source and portable reproduction are included.
